chapitres.competenceChapitre: Master the use of different verb tenses to express time, habits, actions in progress, completed actions, and duration.

objectifsLesson.description: Use present simple for habits and general truths
Use present continuous for actions in progress
Distinguish between the two tenses
Form and use past simple (completed past actions)
Use past continuous (actions in progress in the past)
Express interrupted actions (when + past simple, while + past continuous)
Use present perfect for experiences (ever/never)
Use it for recent actions (just)
Use it with for/since (duration)
Distinguish present perfect and past simple
Use past perfect for an action before another past action
Master tense concordance in the past

lessons.titreLesson: Future Tenses (will, going to, present continuous)

objectifsLesson.description: Distinguish will (spontaneous decision, prediction) and going to (intention, evidence)
Use present continuous for planned future

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Express ability, permission, obligation, advice, probability, and deduction using modal verbs.

objectifsLesson.description: Express ability (can, could)
Ask for and give permission (can, may, could)
Express prohibition (can't, mustn't)

lessons.titreLesson: Obligation and Advice (must, have to, should, ought to)

objectifsLesson.description: Express obligation (must, have to)
Give advice (should, ought to)
Distinguish personal obligation (must) and external obligation (have to)

lessons.titreLesson: Probability and Deduction (might, may, could, must)

objectifsLesson.description: Express probability (might, may, could)
Express certainty (must)
Make logical deductions

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Construct and use conditional sentences to express general truths, possible situations, hypothetical scenarios, and regrets.

objectifsLesson.description: Use type 0 for general truths (if + present, present)
Use type 1 for possible situations (if + present, will + base verb)
Use type 2 for hypothetical situations (if + past, would + base verb)
Use type 3 for regrets and unreal past situations (if + past perfect, would have + past participle)
Use "unless" to mean "except if"
Master conditional inversions (Were I you...)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Transform direct speech into indirect speech, including statements, questions, commands, and requests.

objectifsLesson.description: Transform direct statements into indirect speech
Master tense backshift (present → past, past → past perfect)
Adapt pronouns and time/place adverbs
Report questions (wh-questions and yes/no questions)
Master subject-verb inversion
Report orders (tell + to-infinitive)
Report requests (ask + to-infinitive)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Form and use the passive voice appropriately in different tenses.

objectifsLesson.description: Form the passive in all tenses (be + past participle)
Transform an active sentence into passive
Identify the agent (by)
Use passive when the agent is unknown or unimportant
Distinguish contexts for passive use

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use relative pronouns correctly to connect clauses and provide additional information.

objectifsLesson.description: Use who for people
Use which for things
Use that for people and things
Use whose for possession
Distinguish defining and non-defining relative clauses
Master comma usage

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Form and use question tags correctly in different contexts.

objectifsLesson.description: Form question tags (auxiliary + pronoun)
Master the rule: positive statement → negative tag, negative statement → positive tag
Use tags with I am (aren't I?)
Tags with let's (shall we?)
Tags with imperatives (will you?)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use correlative conjunctions, preference expressions, purpose clauses, and result clauses appropriately.

objectifsLesson.description: Use either...or to express a choice
Use neither...nor for combined negation
Use not only...but also for emphatic addition
Use would rather to express preference
Use had better to give strong advice
Use so + adjective/adverb + that
Use such + (adjective) + noun + that

lessons.titreLesson: In order to / So as to

objectifsLesson.description: Express purpose with in order to, so as to
Form the negative: in order not to, so as not to

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Compare qualities using degrees of comparison and form compound adjectives.

objectifsLesson.description: Form the comparative (er/more)
Form the superlative (est/most)
Use as...as for equality
Form and use compound adjectives (well-known, hard-working)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Acquire and use vocabulary related to governance, citizenship, human rights, and conflict resolution.

objectifsLesson.description: Master governance vocabulary (election, transparency, democracy)
Know citizenship terms (vote, candidate, polling station)
Know human rights vocabulary (rights, discrimination, equality)
Master gender equality terms (gender, privileges, empowerment)
Know violence-related terms (violence, abuse, conflict, fight)
Master conflict resolution vocabulary (peace, negotiation, mediation)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss health issues, diseases, healthcare, and addiction using appropriate vocabulary.

objectifsLesson.description: Know disease vocabulary (Ebola, COVID-19, malaria, HIV/AIDS)
Master symptom terms (fever, headache, cough)
Know medical vocabulary (hospital, clinic, doctor, nurse)
Master treatment terms (vaccine, treatment, cure, medicine)
Know addiction vocabulary (addiction, alcohol, drugs)
Master consequences (health issues, liver disease, withdrawal)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use vocabulary related to school life, academic performance, and online learning.

objectifsLesson.description: Know school-related terms (principal, staff, subjects, classroom)
Master administrative vocabulary (bursar, discipline master, secretary)
Know assessment vocabulary (exam, test, grade, score)
Master success terms (success, outstanding, prize, scholarship)
Know e-learning vocabulary (e-learning, online course)
Master technical terms (internet, computer, platform)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss modern technology, social media, and online shopping using accurate vocabulary.

objectifsLesson.description: Know technology vocabulary (computer, internet, device, gadget)
Master usage terms (download, upload, browse, click)
Know platforms (WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest)
Master communication vocabulary (message, post, share, comment)
Know e-commerce vocabulary (online shop, website, cart, checkout)
Master payment methods (credit card, transfer, mobile money)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use banking, financial, and employment vocabulary appropriately.

objectifsLesson.description: Know banking vocabulary (account, deposit, withdraw, loan)
Master financial terms (interest, credit, debit, ATM)
Know employment vocabulary (job, work, employee, employer)
Master career terms (profession, occupation, salary, wages)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss pollution, environmental issues, and protection measures.

objectifsLesson.description: Know pollution vocabulary (pollution, waste, chemicals)
Master types of pollution (air, water, soil, noise)
Know protection vocabulary (conservation, preservation, protection)
Master ecological actions (recycle, plant trees, reduce waste)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss traditional practices, ceremonies, and chieftaincy institutions.

objectifsLesson.description: Know tradition vocabulary (custom, tradition, ceremony)
Master cultural terms (festival, ritual, celebration)
Know traditional titles (chief, lamido, fon, king)
Master chieftaincy vocabulary (throne, succession, hereditary)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss teenage pregnancy and juvenile delinquency with appropriate vocabulary.

objectifsLesson.description: Know pregnancy vocabulary (pregnancy, teenage mother)
Master causes and consequences (dropout, responsibility, marriage)
Know delinquency vocabulary (crime, violence, misbehavior)
Master discipline terms (suspension, punishment, rehabilitation)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Discuss volunteerism, community service, and development actions.

objectifsLesson.description: Know volunteerism vocabulary (volunteer, voluntary, service)
Master motivations (solidarity, help, community, commitment)
Know development vocabulary (development, infrastructure)
Master community actions (clean-up, fundraising, awareness)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use vocabulary related to means of transport and travel.

objectifsLesson.description: Know transport modes (car, bus, train, plane, canoe)
Master travel vocabulary (trip, journey, travel, destination)

chapitres.competenceChapitre: Use phrasal verbs, prepositions, conjunctions, and word formation strategies correctly.

objectifsLesson.description: Master frequent phrasal verbs (look up, give up, turn down, etc.)
Master preposition usage (at, in, on, by, for)
Use conjunctions correctly (because, although, however, therefore)
Know suffixes to form nouns (-tion, -sion, -ment, -ness)
Know suffixes to form adjectives (-ful, -less, -ive, -ous)
Know negative prefixes (un-, in-, im-, dis-)
